subject: Pillar consolidation + QBR alignment (draft announcement & role mapping)
messages:
From: Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: allhands-comms@redwood.ai, people-ops@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Pillar consolidation + QBR alignment (draft announcement & role mapping)

Team —

Following our leadership sync last week, I've pulled together a draft proposal to consolidate our current three product pillars into two: Platform (Reliability & Serving) and Growth (Developer & Customer Experience). The primary goal is to reduce cross-pillar handoffs that have degraded OKR ownership and to simplify reporting lines ahead of QBR.

High level:
- What: consolidate "Serving" and "Runtime" into a single Platform pillar; combine "Growth" and "Developer Experience" into Growth pillar.
- Why: clearer OKR ownership for latency/cost vs. customer adoption metrics; faster decision cycles for infra vs. product experiments.
- Impact: ~8 manager-level role re-maps, no immediate headcount reductions; some backfills deferred.

Attachments: pillar_proposal_v1.pdf (proposal + comms timeline), role_matrix_draft.xlsx (initial role mapping).

Asks:
1) Please review the attached two-pager and role matrix and provide redlines by EOD Monday (Jun 21).
2) Confirm owner for the internal announcement (All-Hands + department emails) and the external customer note.
3) We need an OKR coverage heatmap that maps existing KR owners to the new pillar leads — can someone take point?

Proposed timeline (tentative):
- Jun 25: dry-run with execs and comms (30m)
- Jun 28: internal announcement (All-Hands + manager briefing)
- Jul 5: customer-facing note and public comms

I'm conscious of the QBR calendar; if shifting the external date by a week reduces risk, say so. Linked the working doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFG-pillar-proposal

Thanks —
Ethan
Ethan Park
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachment: pillar_proposal_v1.pdf; role_matrix_draft.xlsx)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pillar consolidation + QBR alignment (draft announcement & role mapping)

Ethan —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick thoughts after a skim:
- Language: let's avoid the word "reorg" in the initial comms. Recommend "operational alignment" and "pillar consolidation" as the external framing.
- Manager Q&A: we should schedule two manager Q&A slots (one US/EMEA friendly) the day after the internal announcement. People-ops can bake FAQs.
- Role matrix: there are a couple of lines where ownership looks ambiguous (see comments on row 12 and 19 of role_matrix_draft.xlsx). I'll add proposed edits inline.

I can own the manager briefing and the FAQ doc. I won't be able to get a full redline to you until Monday morning, but will put comments tonight. Also +1 on a dry-run.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Ethan / team —

Overall I support the direction. A couple of operational asks before we lock a timeline:
1) OKR coverage mapping: we need a heatmap that shows which KRs are at risk versus which will benefit. I'll volunteer my group to own a first-pass heatmap (delivery Wed Jun 23) but need org owners to confirm the KRs we should include by EOD Mon.
2) Impact on SLAs and Dedicated customers: platform changes could affect routing/ownership for incidents. Ops needs 10 business days to update runbooks if we change pillar boundaries. If we want customer-facing comms on Jul 5, we should do dry-run earlier or push to Jul 12.

One other note: please flag any roles that will be subject to hiring freeze constraints — that will materially change how we present backfills.

-Vivek

From: Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.ai>

Thanks all — excellent, constructive feedback. Quick consolidated plan: 

1) Timeline: dry-run moved to Fri Jun 25 at 14:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Internal announcement still targeted Jun 28; external customer note moved to Jul 12 to give ops + comms extra runway.
2) Owners:
   - Manager briefing + FAQ: Laura (lead) + People Ops
   - Role matrix redlines: Marissa to consolidate and produce role_matrix_final.xlsx
   - Heatmap (OKR coverage): Vivek's team will produce a first-pass by Wed Jun 23; request owners to confirm KRs by Mon Jun 21.
3) Comms framing: replace "reorg" with "operational alignment" in all drafts. All-Hands will include a Q&A segment and a follow-up manager-only breakout.
4) Hiring/backfill language: update to reflect talent constraints (Laura / People Ops to provide final phrasing).
5) Attachments: updated role_matrix_v2.xlsx included; final artifacts will be attached to the internal comms.

Next steps: please confirm you can attend the dry-run (Jun 25 14:00 PT) and indicate any blockers by EOD Thurs Jun 24. I'll prepare a short slide deck for exec run-through and upload to the linked doc.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this feels like a pragmatic path that protects QBR messaging while giving teams time to operationalize changes.

Ethan
Ethan Park
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
